smallest_supported_claim: In the bound native R033 C4 session, the production sound adapter observed the armed charge at minute 8284 and did not observe it after the native one-minute wait at 8285.  The camp did not consume the sound because its only structural observer was ineligible due to an active external operation, so this run does not establish a camp clue, returned report, or save/reload persistence.
causal_account: The initial World observation retained the active C4 source and the native production channel recorded a significant sound.  The accepted ordinary native wait reached the next minute, where the source was absent and the sound channel reported absent.  The production scheduler facts identify the observer rejection as an active external operation or unresolved reservation; the run-bound debug record consequently reports zero eligible observers and zero callbacks.  That prevents a causal camp-read or report-provenance claim.  No debug intervention, direct state mutation, fixture reinstall, or replay was used.
